vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.t:
The grouping feature only affects hotbar scrolling.
This feature only affects scrolling from the trackpad (and other high precision devices).
Default: 20.0
0.0: Disable custom trackpad scroll processing.
Other: group scrolls together to make scrolling speed much more reasonable on hotbar, scroll amount is divided by the value chosen here.
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.m:
Only affects hotbar scrolling.
A momentum scroll is when macOS keeps scrolling after you release the wheel.
Default: OFF
OFF: ignore 'momentum scroll' events.
ON: process 'momentum scroll' events.
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.s:
Affects all scrolling from legacy input devices (except for the hotbar).
macOS sometimes adjusts how much a single scroll does to make it feel 'smoother', but this can cause scroll amounts to feel random sometimes.
Default: OFF
OFF: Modify smooth scrolling events to all be the same scroll amount.
ON: Keep smooth scrolling events as-is.
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.d:
When enabled, disables the fix for the bug which causes Minecraft
to map Control + Left Click to Right Click.
Default: OFF
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.u:
When enabled, uses the P3 color space for rendering instead of sRGB.
This reverts the fix made in Minecraft 26.2+
with the new Vulkan renderer, that causes colors to be less vibrant.
Requires game restart to take effect.
Default: OFF
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.r:
Reverses the direction that scrolling goes for the hotbar when enabled.
Default: OFF
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.l:
Ignores scrolling while the attack key is held down and you are in game (no screen open).
Useful on a Magic Mouse or trackpad, where a small finger movement while mining
causes an accidental scroll that switches the selected hotbar item.
Default: OFF
OFF: scrolling always works.
ON: scrolling is ignored while the attack key is held down.
vanilla-finest-fixes.macos_input_fixes.r:
Reverses the direction of all scrolling when enabled.
Default: OFF
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.title: Better Happy Ghast Controls Config
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.new_p: Create a new client profile you can toggle between in-game.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.profi: Enter a name for this profile.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.maste: Sets a consistent speed for all Happy Ghast movements. This simply sets all other speed settings at once.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.forwa: Sets the Happy Ghast speed while moving forward (W by default).
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.ascen: Sets the Happy Ghast speed while ascending vertically (Space Bar by default).
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.backw: Sets the Happy Ghast speed while moving backward (S by default).
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.desce: Sets the Happy Ghast speed while descending vertically (Left Ctrl by default).
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.straf: Sets the Happy Ghast speed while moving sideways (A and D by default).
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.autom: Adjusts the Happy Ghast vertical position while moving forward based on whether the player is looking up or down.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.fixed: Fixes the Happy Ghast rotation to center around the player rider, allowing more precision while stationary and looking around.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.smoot: Sets whether movements are smooth or instant while riding Happy Ghasts. Turn OFF for more precise movement.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.desce: Select whether to use the Sneak/Crouch key to Descend while riding a Happy Ghast, or to only use the custom Descend keybind. If using Double-Tap to Dismount, this should use Custom Keybind only.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.speed: Apply a speed boost multiplier when pressing the Sprint key while riding Happy Ghasts. Double-tapping forward also boosts based on the global Minecraft setting. Resulting speed must be within the server maxiumum.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.dismo: Select whether to require double tapping the Sneak/Crouch key to dismount while riding Happy Ghasts, or to apply the standard single tap Sneak/Crouch to dismount behaviour.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.doubl: Time window in ticks where double-tapping the Sneak/Crouch key dismounts the Happy Ghast. Only applies when Dismount is set to Double-Tap.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.disab: Makes all Happy Ghasts stop roaming while not being ridden. Only applies when wearing a Harness.
Turn ON to silence all Happy Ghast ambient sounds (does not affect hurt/death sounds). Turn OFF to maintain all original sounds.
Turn ON to allow players to destroy blocks at normal speed while riding a Happy Ghast. Turn OFF to keep the default 5x slowness applied for not being on ground.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.reach: Sets the distance players can reach blocks and entities while riding a Happy Ghast. Normal reach is 4.5 blocks.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.ghast: Set the size of all Happy Ghasts to be smaller (or bigger). Normal size is 1.0.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.defau: Sets the default speed while riding Happy Ghasts. This also applies the default speed for anyone not using the client-side mod. Normal speed is 1.0.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.minim: Sets the minimum client speed settings allowed while riding Happy Ghasts. Normal speed is 1.0. Overrides any client config that exeeds this.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.maxim: Sets the maximum client speed settings allowed while riding Happy Ghasts. Normal speed is 1.0. Overrides any client config that exeeds this.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.delet: This will permanently delete the profile. This cannot be undone.
vanilla-finest-fixes.ghastcontrols.serve: %s This is managed by the server.
